notes.title: A Walk in the Woods has released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! A Walk in the Woods has finally gone live! All of us here at Something Dark Studios are looking forward to the Steam community playing our game and we cannot wait to receive your feedback. We want to thank those who have supported us through development and are very excited to finally share this experience that the studio has worked so hard to create.

Please share any bugs or issues you find and we will work hard to address them. We also encourage the community to post screenshots, share artwork, and come up with any guides that might help your fellow players. Feel free to ask the development team any questions and we will respond as soon as we can. 

Thank you all for your support and please enjoy the game!

Sincerely,

Something Dark Studios
